file: library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2026/2026 - Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling of Cross-League Performance Translation in Elite Football - Shaikh.pdf
title: Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling of Cross-League Performance Translation in Elite Football
one_line: Hierarchical Bayesian 'league tax' for players transferring into the Premier League; uses within-league transfers as an untreated control to separate club-change shock from league effect, and grades itself on 90% HDI coverage rather than MAE.

file: 2026 Lineup Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus (L-RAPM) - Petridis, Pelechrinis.pdf
title: Lineup Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus (L-RAPM): Basketball Lineup Ratings with Informed Priors
one_line: Rates lineups instead of players by shrinking lineup ridge coefficients toward a prior built from summed player RAPM; the only public method that can rate a lineup that has never played, and the gain grows as the lineup gets thinner.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2026/2026 - WINSCORE revisited - A model-based evaluation of player performance in the NBA and EuroLeague - Carta, Favero.md
title: WINSCORE revisited: A model-based evaluation of player performance in the NBA and EuroLeague
one_line: Re-derives Berri's WINSCORE as a two-parameter possession model whose box-score weights fall out of simulation rather than assumption; encompassing tests retire PIR, and a role-plus-minutes caliper fixes the low-minute extrapolation that inflates every role benchmark.

file: 2024 Lasso Multinomial Performance Indicators for in-play Basketball Data - Damoulaki, Ntzoufras, Pelechrinis.pdf
title: Lasso Multinomial Performance Indicators for in-play Basketball Data
one_line: Bake-off of ridge vs lasso vs binary/multinomial-logit RAPM over 322,852 NBA possessions; the winner, wEPTS, models points-per-possession as the discrete 0-3 variable it actually is and weights each player by possession share.

file: 2017 iWinRNFL - A Simple, Interpretable and Well-Calibrated In-Game Win Probability Model for NFL - Pelechrinis.pdf
title: iWinRNFL: A Simple, Interpretable & Well-Calibrated In-Game Win Probability Model for NFL
one_line: Ten-variable logistic in-game WP on 7 seasons of public pbp; 75% winner accuracy, well calibrated, and non-linear models on identical features bought nothing - a useful negative result for anyone reaching for a bigger learner.

file: 2024 Understanding team collapse via probabilistic graphical models - Nikolaou, Pelechrinis, Terzi.pdf
title: Understanding team collapse via probabilistic graphical models
one_line: Graphical model of team dynamics with learnable parameters, used to locate the causes of team collapse and state principles for resilient teams; NBA application is diagnostic rather than a shipping metric.

file: 2022 Implicit Biases in Refereeing - Lessons from NBA Referees - Pelechrinis.pdf
title: Implicit Biases in Refereeing: Lessons from NBA Referees
one_line: Home bias in NBA officiating is real and playoff-amplified but shrank after COVID; specific players draw favourable calls beyond chance, while team-level and racial bias show nothing - built entirely on public Last Two Minutes reports.

file: 2017 tHoops - A Multi-Aspect Analytical Framework for Spatio-Temporal Basketball Data - Papalexakis, Pelechrinis.pdf
title: tHoops: A Multi-Aspect Analytical Framework for Spatio-Temporal Basketball Data
one_line: PARAFAC decomposition of an entity-by-location-by-time tensor into interpretable prototype spatio-temporal patterns, with a rule for choosing the component count; every entity becomes a weighted mix of the prototypes.

file: 2016 The Anatomy of the Three-Point Shot - Spatial Bias, Fractals and the Three-Point Line in the NBA - Pelechrinis.pdf
title: The Anatomy of the Three-Point Shot: Spatial Bias, Fractals and the Three-Point Line in the NBA
one_line: Shot attempts jump discontinuously across the three-point line while field goal percentage does not, so shooters are behaving rationally and it is the line's placement that wastes the space just inside it.

file: 2016 Footballonomics - The Anatomy of American Football - Pelechrinis, Papalexakis.pdf
title: Footballonomics: The Anatomy of American Football; Evidence from 7 years of NFL game data
one_line: Rejects the rational-coaching hypothesis on PAT and fourth-down decisions across 2009-2015, then shows a small logistic plus bootstrap reaches ~63% game accuracy - comparable to far more complex systems.

file: 2019 DeepHoops - Evaluating Micro-Actions in Basketball Using Deep Feature Representations - Sicilia, Pelechrinis, Goldsberry.pdf
title: DeepHoops: Evaluating Micro-Actions in Basketball Using Deep Feature Representations of Spatio-Temporal Data
one_line: Deep sequence model over tracking data emitting a running expected-points stream, framed as multi-class terminal-action classification with a parameterised downsampling scheme for class imbalance; values off-ball actions no box score sees.

file: 2021 The Anatomy of Corner 3s in the NBA - Pelechrinis, Goldsberry.pdf
title: The Anatomy of Corner 3s in the NBA: What makes them efficient, how are they generated and how can defenses respond?
one_line: Corner threes are efficient because they are assisted over 90% of the time, not because they are shorter; the defensive game solved here has a Nash equilibrium of committing to the corner or to the drive, never lingering.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2026/2026 - Nuthin But A G League - Estimating league translation factors - Glazer.md
title: Nuthin' But A G League: Estimating league translation factors
one_line: First causal framing of league translation: genetic matching plus difference-in-differences against same-league stayers, which nets out aging and development so the residual is the league and not the move; G League to NBA factors come out directionally like the same-season method but consistently smaller.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2025/2025 - A predictive metamodel for college football - Coleman.md
title: A predictive metamodel for college football
one_line: Forward selection by cross-validated PSSE over 29 CFB rating systems and 5,925 games picks a five-system ensemble that reaches 12.30 MAE and 74.1% winners on 2023-24, statistically significant in the presence of the opening line.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2023/2023 - A causal approach for detecting team-level momentum in NBA games - Weimer, Steinert-Threlkeld, Coltin.md
title: A causal approach for detecting team-level momentum in NBA games
one_line: Uses TV timeouts as an exogenous pause to identify momentum causally: the team on a run scores 11.2% fewer points in the next three minutes, an effect larger than an opponent substitution and not explained by mean reversion.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2026/2026 - mWAR - A Bayesian estimator of manager value - Kahan.md
title: mWAR: A Bayesian estimator of manager value
one_line: Multilevel Bayesian manager estimator over 500+ MLB managers since 1901; gates itself on a simulated null before estimating anything, then reports each manager against a region of practical equivalence rather than a point estimate.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2023/2023 - Predictions of european basketball match results with machine learning algorithms - Lampis et al.md
title: Predictions of european basketball match results with machine learning algorithms
one_line: Elo, PageRank and pi-rating features tuned per tournament lift box-score models across four European leagues and 5,214 games - and the lift is smallest in the EuroLeague, the most competitively balanced of them.

file: md/library/journals/International Journal of Sports Science and Coaching/2017/2017 - Big data analytics for modeling scoring probability in basketball - Zuccolotto, Manisera, Sandri - METADATA ONLY.md
title: Big data analytics for modeling scoring probability in basketball: The effect of shooting under high-pressure conditions
one_line: CART over jointly-considered high-pressure situations yields new shooting measures, fit on Italian Serie A2 and validated on Rio 2016. SCORED FROM ABSTRACT ONLY - closed access, no full text held.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2026/2026 - Concurrent validity of computer-vision AI player tracking software using broadcast footage - Crang et al.md
title: Concurrent validity of computer-vision artificial intelligence player tracking software using broadcast footage
one_line: Three commercial broadcast-video tracking providers against TRACAB Gen 5 on one World Cup match: total distance bias spans -21.8% to +24.3% between providers, so use a tactical feed and treat provider choice as a first-order decision.

file: md/library/journals/Journal of Sports Analytics/2025/2025 - How to assess leader capabilities - Applying AI algorithms to evaluate NBA head coaches - Kim, Lee.md
title: How to assess leader capabilities: Applying AI algorithms to evaluate NBA head coaches
one_line: Treats the residual between a prior-season-roster win prediction and actual results as the head coach's marginal contribution over 772 team-seasons; the residual is attributed to coaching by assumption, with no null test.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Analyzing the Value of Starting Pitchers vs Relief Pitchers in MLB - Jha et al.md
title: Analyzing the Value of Starting Pitchers vs Relief Pitchers in MLB
one_line: Slide-deck correlations of 2019 team starter/reliever innings, payroll share, WAR and AAV/WAR; concludes starters are the better investment from single-season 30-team correlations.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Creating a Better Pythagorean Expectation for Basketball - Zhuang et al.md
title: Creating a Better Pythagorean Expectation for Basketball
one_line: Slide deck swaps points for offensive/defensive rating with exponent 2 and multiplies by an ad hoc strength-of-schedule term, claiming r-squared .94 vs .49; no data source, validation design or holdout.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Finding the NBA Draft Diamonds in the Rough - Batra et al.md
title: Finding the NBA Draft Diamonds in the Rough

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Go For It A Data Driven Analysis of NFL 4th Downs - Lerman et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Hot Hand Fallacy, Fallacy, Fallacy - Babitz.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - How Rare is Pete Alonso s 53 Home Run Season - Burlant et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - In a Rush to Pass NFL Teams Pass on Rushing - Cramer et al.md
title: In a Rush to Pass: NFL Teams Pass on Rushing

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Optimal Pitch Spin Rate and Velocity to Maximize Whiff Rate - Park et al.md
title: Optimal Pitch: Spin Rate & Velocity to Maximize Whiff Rate

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Quantifying NBA play style drift using Finite Mixture Multinomial model - Castle et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Rocket League esports - Lee et al.md
title: Rocket League: esports

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Seattle Kraken Expansion Draft Strategic Approaches - Malter et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Introducing Grid WAR Rethinking WAR for Starting Pitchers - Brill et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Predicting the Quarterback-MVP in the NFL - Brill et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Running to Runs the Importance of Baserunning - Patel et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Stars Matter an Analysis of College Football Recruiting, Development, and Draft Success - Kessman et al.md
title: Stars Matter: an Analysis of College Football Recruiting, Development, and Draft Success
one_line: Poster regressing 247 composite recruiting-class ratings on total draft value to rank programs by development residual and consistency; simple, with years unstated.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - The 2021-2022 Liaoning Flying Leopards The Best Championship Team in Franchise History - Yue et al.md
title: The 2021-2022 Liaoning Flying Leopards: The Best Championship Team in Franchise History
one_line: Poster comparing the 2017-18 and 2021-22 Liaoning Flying Leopards on true shooting, turnover rate and efficiency-differential z-scores; descriptive, with no model.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - The Importance of Break Point Percentage - Yu et al.md
title: The Importance of Break Point Percentage
one_line: Compares break-point conversion of winners and losers across 2,385 2021 ATP matches by surface; a near-tautological descriptive result from a one-page poster.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Whether Weather, Wind Speed and Temperature, Impacts Offensive Success in the NFL - Parks et al.md
title: Whether Weather, Wind Speed and Temperature, Impacts Offensive Success in the NFL

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2022/2022 - Zero Running Backs or Zero Points An Analysis on the Optimal Fantasy Football Draft Strategy - Heller et al.md
title: Zero Running Backs or Zero Points: An Analysis on the Optimal Fantasy Football Draft Strategy
one_line: Monte Carlo snake-draft simulation with normally distributed ADP compares Zero-RB to a standard strategy over 10 seasons and finds no consistent edge; poster-level detail, hand-cleaned data.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - An Investigation of Sports Betting Selection and Sizing - Beggy et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Calculating NBA MVPs Using Advanced Sports Analytics - Shen et al.md

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Effect of Increased Three-point Shot Attempts on Probability of Winning in High School Basketball - Kostacos.md

file: https://wsb.wharton.upenn.edu/predicting-march-madness-cinderella-teams/
title: Predicting March Madness Cinderella Teams

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Why Did They Succeed A World Cup 2022 Analysis - Lim et al.md
title: Why Did They Succeed? A World Cup 2022 Analysis

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Algorithmic NBA Player Acquisition - Brill et al.md
title: Algorithmic NBA Player Acquisition

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Are Surprise Teams in the MLB in 2023 More Surprising - Federico et al.md
title: Are “Surprise Teams” in the MLB in 2023 More Surprising?

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - More Than The Sum of Their Parts Evaluating Defensive Line Construction and Deployment - Shah et al.md
title: More Than The Sum of Their Parts: Evaluating Defensive Line Construction and Deployment

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Optimal Rest Days for Pitchers Maximizing Performance and Wins - Zilberman et al.md
title: Optimal Rest Days for Pitchers: Maximizing Performance and Wins

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Optimal Strategy for Defensive Pressure in American Football Insights from an Expected Sack Model - Seth.md
title: Optimal Strategy for Defensive Pressure in American Football: Insights from an Expected Sack Model

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Serving to Win A Statistical Exploration of Optimal Serves in Beach Volleyball - Zeng.md
title: Serving to Win: A Statistical Exploration of Optimal Serves in Beach Volleyball
one_line: Descriptive comparison of serve types and target zones across ~200,000 FIVB 2022 women's beach volleyball serves; finds jump-topspin more effective despite more errors, no controls for server skill.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Sidelined Using Natural Language Processing to Investigate Gender Bias in Basketball Sports Journalism - Yellin.md
title: Sidelined: Using Natural Language Processing to Investigate Gender Bias in Basketball Sports Journalism
one_line: Scrapes about 1,700 ESPN.com NCAA basketball articles to compare coverage volume and AFINN adjective sentiment by gender, presented in a Shiny app; descriptive, lexicon-based, one-day snapshot.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - A Holistic Examination of Streakiness and Consistency in Major League Baseball - Feder.md
title: A Holistic Examination of Streakiness and Consistency in Major League Baseball
one_line: Applies Albert-style streak and spacing scores with block-permutation tests to 2023 Statcast PA- and swing-level outcomes for 136 hitters and 127 pitchers, relating consistency to traditional stats; simulation-checked, single season.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Analysis of Success Probabilities in Field Hockey with Machine Learning - Lee.md
title: Analysis of Success Probabilities in Field Hockey with Machine Learning
one_line: Fits player random-effect logistic models (glmer and RStan) to 270 shots from one Northeastern season; a new sport for analytics, but a tiny sample and the two fits disagree on key signs.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Analyzing Force in Tackling with the Creation of the Force Over Expected Metric - Yoo et al.md
title: Analyzing Force in Tackling with the Creation of the Force Over Expected Metric
one_line: Defines tackle force from mass, acceleration and movement angles in BDB 2024 tracking and fits a linear 'force over expected'; the physics is rough, R^2 is 0.49, and outliers were dropped after the fit.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Evaluating the Impact of Special Teams on Winning - Ladden et al.md
title: Evaluating the Impact of Special Teams on Winning
one_line: Builds decision-neutral special-teams EPA from a drive-start EP curve, sums it into STPI and regresses win% on STPI plus PFR OSRS/DSRS; the per-play conclusions rest on a crude play-count ratio.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Exploring the Evolution of the NFL Draft Pick Trade Market Over Time - Nathanson.md
title: Exploring the Evolution of the NFL Draft Pick Trade Market Over Time
one_line: Refits the Massey-Thaler Weibull pick-value model on rolling ten-year windows of pick-only trades 1983-2023, tracking volume, discount rate, consensus and steepness; clear but descriptive.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - High Value Football Transfers A Win or Loss Correlation of High Value Football Transfers, with their Subsequent Performances - Mittal.md
title: High Value Football Transfers: A Win or Loss? Correlation of High Value Football Transfers, with their Subsequent Performances
one_line: Averages two-year Transfermarkt market-value changes for the ten priciest transfers per position per season 2017-2020; descriptive bar charts, no correlation computed despite the title, conclusions overreach.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Quantifying NFL Quarterback Aggressiveness Using aDOT Over Expected (AYOE) - Vignesh.md
title: Quantifying NFL Quarterback Aggressiveness Using aDOT Over Expected (AYOE)
one_line: XGBoost expected-air-yards model on nflfastR PBP (train 2014-2020, test 2021-2023) yields QB aDOT over expected with a receiver-trust input; finds no link to EPA/pass; incremental on prior AYOE work.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - SET Spatial Edge Technique A Framework to Evaluate Edge Setters - Bhatia et al.md
title: SET: Spatial Edge Technique – A Framework to Evaluate Edge Setters
one_line: Big Data Bowl metric scoring edge-setting by overlap of a defender’s Voronoi region with a projected runner density plus the induced inside cut angle; novel target, unvalidated against outcomes.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - The Sharpe Ratio and Hitter Evaluation A New Application of Modern Portfolio Theory - Knight.md
title: The Sharpe Ratio and Hitter Evaluation: A New Application of Modern Portfolio Theory
one_line: Recasts SLG/(K/BB) as a hitter 'Sharpe ratio' and argues plate-discipline 'volatility' is stickier than output via year-over-year R²; college case studies use undisclosed self-built metrics.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Understanding the Relationship Between Mental Health Literacy and Grit in a Sample of High School Female Athletes - Hone.md
title: Understanding the Relationship Between Mental Health Literacy and Grit in a Sample of High School Female Athletes
one_line: Surveys 48 rural-Utah high-school girls (27 athletes) on mental health literacy, grit and mental toughness; Mann-Whitney and Spearman tests on a tiny Facebook-recruited convenience sample.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Using a Novel Metric of Expected Points Above Average (EPAA) Versus Salary to Assess 2023 National Football League Kicker Value - Gandhi.md
title: Using a Novel Metric of Expected Points Above Average (EPAA) Versus Salary to Assess 2023 National Football League Kicker Value
one_line: Weather-adjusted logistic kick model on nflfastR 2015-2023 yields kicker points above average, compared with 2023 salaries (no correlation found); standard FG-over-expected idea, sensibly executed.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Beyond the Boundary Revolutionizing the IPL MVP Index - Rajaram et al.md
title: Beyond the Boundary: Revolutionizing the IPL MVP Index
one_line: Builds league-relative batting and bowling metrics for IPL 2021-2024 and weights them by regressing team win% on aggregated z-scores; about 30 training team-seasons, test R2 0.80 on 10 teams.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Calculating Win Probabilities of Any Matchup of Soccer Teams A Whole-History Rating Approach for the Wharton High School Data Science Compet - Seung et al.md
title: Calculating Win Probabilities of Any Matchup of Soccer Teams: A Whole-History Rating Approach for the Wharton High School Data Science Competition
one_line: Multi-pass Elo/Bradley-Terry rating weighted by xG differential, tuned by Nelder-Mead, for the fictional WHSDSC soccer league; first-place competition entry with an 80/20 split RMSE.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Clutch Matches Are In The Middle Optimizing OPR with Weighted Least Squares - Krotkov et al.md
title: Clutch Matches Are In The Middle: Optimizing OPR with Weighted Least Squares
one_line: Applies weighted least squares by match position to FRC OPR across 2009-2024 district events; the LOOCV gain is only 0.4%, and the 'clutch' framing overstates a small heteroskedasticity fix.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - College Basketball An In-depth Study of the Foul Up 3 Dilemma - Zapata-Hall.md
title: College Basketball: An In-depth Study of the “Foul Up 3” Dilemma
one_line: Builds a game-clock x shot-clock grid from 2010-2022 NCAA D-I PBP plus a coach survey to recommend foul/no-foul up 3 per cell by overtime-adjusted win%; coachable but no uncertainty.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Examining regional and familiarity bias of referees in USA Fencing Division I bouts - Lipkovitz.md
title: Examining regional and familiarity bias of referees in USA Fencing Division I bouts
one_line: Regresses 35,111 USA Fencing Division I pool-bout margins and wins on referee-fencer same-region status, exploiting quasi-random referee assignment; finds no favoritism in foil/saber and a small epee effect.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Expected Value Curves Don t Tell the Full Story Exploring NFL Draft Position Trade Value Curves - Zilberman et al.md
title: Expected Value Curves Don’t Tell the Full Story: Exploring NFL Draft Position Trade Value Curves
one_line: Models the full density of second-contract value by draft slot with beta regression and shows eliteness-weighted value functions give steeper curves that match the trade market; clear and useful.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - Exploring various NBA draft value curves - Bewtra et al.md
title: Exploring various NBA draft value curves
one_line: Builds 12 mean/median NBA draft value curves from BPM, RAPTOR and WAR, mapping performance to salary share via Gamma regression to keep curves positive; shows the curves diverge widely but recommends none.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2024/2024 - To Go for Two or Not to Go for Two A Statistical Analysis of the Biggest Prisoner s Dilemma in the National Football League - Venkatesh et al.md
title: To Go for Two or Not to Go for Two? A Statistical Analysis of the Biggest Prisoner’s Dilemma in the National Football League
one_line: Compares extra-point and two-point conversion rates before and after the 2015 XP move with nflfastR; expected-value tables and a two-point linear distance extrapolation, no game-state modeling.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Adjusting Double Poisson Models to Predict the NCAA Division I Softball Championship - Smith et al.md
title: Adjusting Double Poisson Models to Predict the NCAA Division I Softball Championship
one_line: Replaces MLE Double Poisson strengths with run-average ratios plus ad hoc conference and schedule adjustment factors and simulates the 2024 NCAA softball tournament 2,000 times; one season, stage-level accuracy only.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Analyze Tennis Winning Factors Across Different Surfaces By Utilizing Random Forest - Deng.md
title: Analyze Tennis Winning Factors Across Different Surfaces By Utilizing Random Forest
one_line: Fits per-surface random forests on within-match serve, winner and error rates from 1,103 Slam matches and reads MDI importance and partial dependence; descriptive, since in-match rates nearly define the result.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Deal or No Deal How NFL Teams May Be Better Off in the Draft - Vinchurkar.md
title: Deal or No Deal? – How NFL Teams May Be Better Off in the Draft
one_line: Descriptive comparison of 2018-2022 draft-pick counts, playoff appearances and Forbes revenue with case-study anecdotes; concludes drafting and market size matter, but runs no statistical tests or controls.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Defensive Motor Index (DMI) A New Metric for Evaluating Defensive Effort and Impact in the NBA - Gurijala.md
title: Defensive Motor Index (DMI): A New Metric for Evaluating Defensive Effort and Impact in the NBA
one_line: Proposes a weighted composite of hustle stats (deflections, loose balls, contests, transition defense, steals+blocks) as a Defensive Motor Index; weights ad hoc, results anecdotal, no correlations reported.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Stats and Stumps Using Machine Learning to Predict T20I Matches with Player and Venue Data - Sharma.md
title: Stats & Stumps: Using Machine Learning to Predict T20I Matches with Player and Venue Data
one_line: Builds hand-tuned batting/bowling impact scores with venue scaling and compares elastic net, random forest and SVM for T20I winners; 70% accuracy, likely leaky ratings, code released.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Testing the Bottleneck Hypothesis in Professional Tennis Rankings - Richey et al.md
title: Testing the ‘Bottleneck’ Hypothesis in Professional Tennis Rankings
one_line: Tests whether the ATP's 2024 ranking-points reallocation created a top-100 bottleneck via stickiness t-tests, points totals, Elo-vs-rank plots and hypothetical schedules; timely policy question, pilot-level evidence.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - The Risk and the Reward An In-depth Evaluation of Strategic Aggressiveness in Men s Tennis - Venkatesh et al.md
title: The Risk and the Reward: An In-depth Evaluation of Strategic Aggressiveness in Men’s Tennis
one_line: Hand-weighted shot aggressiveness scores from Match Charting Project data, k-means player tiers and an XGBoost reward model recommend aggressiveness by score and rank context; the metric is ad hoc and unvalidated.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - To What Extent Do Socioeconomic Factors Such as HDI, Continental Origin, and Previous Host Advantage Affect Paralympic Medal Winning - Elagamawy et al.md
title: To What Extent Do Socioeconomic Factors Such as HDI, Continental Origin, and Previous Host Advantage Affect Paralympic Medal Winning?
one_line: Descriptive inequality analysis (SD, Theil index, Lorenz curve, one-sample t-tests) of Paris 2024 Paralympic medals by HDI, continent and past-host status; one Games, no multivariate model.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Using Machine Learning to Construct Optimal Team Rosters in the Modern NBA - Patel.md
title: Using Machine Learning to Construct Optimal Team Rosters in the Modern NBA
one_line: Clusters player-seasons into ten k-means archetypes and fits XGBoost on 300 team-seasons to rank 39,853 hypothetical rosters; with no holdout and no control for talent, the conclusions are weak.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - A Comparative Analysis of Rating Systems in the US Junior Tennis Development Pathway - Abramson.md
title: A Comparative Analysis of Rating Systems in the US Junior Tennis Development Pathway
one_line: Scrapes 70,822 USTA junior matches with weekly UTR, WTN and USTA rankings; UTR predicts winners best (78.5%) and shows least sectional bias, using simple accuracy and McNemar tests.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - A Run Expectancy Approach to Lead Distance Optimization in Major League Baseball - Dodson et al.md
title: A Run Expectancy Approach to Lead Distance Optimization in Major League Baseball
one_line: Nested logistic models of pickoff and steal stages on MLB-provided 2024 lead-distance data map leads to expected runs and an optimal lead; clear and interpretable, but run gains are tiny.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - AI Special Feature AI-Assisted Substitution Decisions A Fuzzy Logic Approach to Real-Time Game Management - Farias.md
title: AI Special Feature: AI-Assisted Substitution Decisions: A Fuzzy Logic Approach to Real-Time Game Management
one_line: Builds a Mamdani fuzzy-logic substitution-priority system from PlayeRank, minutes, age and yellow cards on Wyscout data; validated only by four hand-picked scenarios using post-match aggregates.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Beyond the Hot Hand Skill, Experience, and Context as Determinants of Elite Badminton Performance - Kuthiala.md
title: Beyond the Hot Hand: Skill, Experience, and Context as Determinants of Elite Badminton Performance
one_line: Elo, logistic regression and XGBoost predict 3,761 BWF men's singles matches (76.5% accuracy); importance ranks skill and experience over recent form, but the experience feature leaks future matches.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Boosting Draft Accuracy A Two-Stage Classifier Regressor Approach for NFL Wide Receiver Prospect Evaluation - Patangi.md
title: Boosting Draft Accuracy: A Two-Stage Classifier–Regressor Approach for NFL Wide Receiver Prospect Evaluation
one_line: Two-stage gradient-boosting classifier and CatBoost regressor predict whether and where combine-invited WRs are drafted; 89% accuracy, 49-pick MAE across four leave-one-season-out folds.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Forecasting NFL Wide Receiver Touchdowns with a Temporal Linear Regression Model - Chung.md
title: Forecasting NFL Wide Receiver Touchdowns with a Temporal Linear Regression Model
one_line: OLS on PFR wide-receiver seasons (train 1990-2010, test 2011-2024) reports R2 0.80 for touchdown totals, likely inflated by same-season efficiency and red-zone features.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Modeling Realistic Placement Probabilities in Speedcubing Using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) - Saito.md
title: Modeling Realistic Placement Probabilities in Speedcubing Using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE)
one_line: Simulates WCA speedcubing placements from per-competitor Gaussian KDEs of recent solves with bootstrapped Ao5s; evaluated on one 15-podium-spot local competition with no psych-sheet baseline.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Multi-Model Consensus an Ensemble Approach to Basketball Predictions - Gupta.md
title: Multi-Model Consensus: an Ensemble Approach to Basketball Predictions
one_line: Builds Elo, weighted Four Factors, temporal logistic and PageRank models on a 2021-22 NCAA WBB competition dataset and compares their matchup probabilities; no accuracy against outcomes is reported.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Optimizing Lead Distance - Whitney-Epstein et al.md
title: Optimizing Lead Distance
one_line: Slide deck fitting GLMs for steal, caught-stealing and pickoff odds on lead distance, pitcher threat, pop time and speed to find run-maximizing leads; a good question, thinly documented.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - PRSS A New Metric to Quantify Pocket Collapses in the National Football League - Hafiz et al.md
title: PRSS: A New Metric to Quantify Pocket Collapses in the National Football League
one_line: Defines PRSS, the steepest smoothed shrinkage rate of the quarterback's Voronoi cell, on 2023 Big Data Bowl tracking; sensible team rankings but validation is a binned-mean R-squared against yards.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Quantifying the Drivers of Serve Effectiveness in Men s Tennis - Chen et al.md
title: Quantifying the Drivers of Serve Effectiveness in Men’s Tennis
one_line: Player-level OLS of US Open first-serve efficiency (points won within three shots) on speed, first-serve % and location entropy; speed dominates, out-of-sample r=0.39, code released.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Re-evaluating the Qualifying Finish Relationship in Formula One A Replication and Correction of Prior Findings - Weissbock et al.md
title: Re-evaluating the Qualifying/Finish Relationship in Formula One: A Replication and Correction of Prior Findings
one_line: Replicates Muhlbauer's grid-finish contingency analysis, then extends it to the full field 2006-2023 with Spearman and ordinal logit, finding qualifying beats grid; careful but descriptive.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Using Injury-Risk Forecasting to Quantify Financial Impact in the NBA - Wang.md
title: Using Injury-Risk Forecasting to Quantify Financial Impact in the NBA
one_line: Random forest on Kaggle box-score workload and injury-history features predicts next-game NBA injury (69% recall, 62% specificity at a 2% threshold) and converts risk to salary-based expected cost.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Using Markov Chains and Statistical Analysis to Model Intentional Fouling Situations in NCAA Division 1 Men s Basketball - Sengupta.md
title: Using Markov Chains and Statistical Analysis to Model Intentional Fouling Situations in NCAA Division 1 Men’s Basketball
one_line: Markov-chain expected points for possessions versus one-and-one and double-bonus free throws by NCAA D1 team and shooter (2024-25 ESPN PBP); ignores clock time and win probability.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - A Unified Server Quality Metric for Tennis - Li et al.md
title: A Unified Server Quality Metric for Tennis
one_line: Fits crossed server/returner logistic GLMMs on Grand Slam point-level serve speed and placement to build a Server Quality Score; careful out-of-sample benchmarks against wElo and ablations, weak second-serve signal.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Age-Structured Transition Analysis of Competitive Exit in U.S. Fencing Continuation, Temporary Absence, Return, and Terminal Non-Return - Liu.md
title: Age-Structured Transition Analysis of Competitive Exit in U.S. Fencing: Continuation, Temporary Absence, Return, and Terminal Non-Return
one_line: Builds an athlete-age panel of 13,206 USA Fencing members to estimate continuation, gap-return and terminal non-return probabilities by weapon and sex; clear descriptive transition analysis, no covariates or formal inference.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - All-Star Based Evaluation of Draft Value Curves Across Major North American Sports Leagues - Abell et al.md
title: All-Star Based Evaluation of Draft Value Curves Across Major North American Sports Leagues
one_line: Fits cubic B-splines of All-Star (Pro Bowl) probability and appearances by draft slot for NFL, NBA, NHL and MLB; clear cross-league comparison, descriptive with no uncertainty bands.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Beyond the Expert An Algorithmic Approach to Correcting Expert Bias in Fantasy Football Projections - Jayanti.md
title: Beyond the Expert: An Algorithmic Approach to Correcting Expert Bias in Fantasy Football Projections
one_line: Position-specific XGBoost regressors on 1,933 lagged season features project 2025 PPR ranks against ESPN preseason projections; one test season, ESPN better for RB/WR, model better on QB/TE ordering.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Integrating Dynamic Defensive Geometry and Match-State Context in Probabilistic Shot Quality Assessment An Advanced Expected Goals Modeling - Singh.md
title: Integrating Dynamic Defensive Geometry and Match-State Context in Probabilistic Shot Quality Assessment: An Advanced Expected Goals Modeling Framework
one_line: XGBoost xG on StatsBomb open data adding freeze-frame pressure features (angular pressure, keeper distance) and a Streamlit app; open code, but AUC 0.878 and beats-industry claims are overstated.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Kicking for Goal or Touch An Expected Points Framework for Penalty Decisions in Rugby Union - Watts et al.md
title: Kicking for Goal or Touch? An Expected Points Framework for Penalty Decisions in Rugby Union
one_line: Builds a multinomial next-score EP surface for lineouts and an angle-distance make model with miss continuation value to map kick-at-goal vs kick-to-touch frontiers; match-cluster bootstrap, code released.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Opponent-Adjusted Evaluation of NFL Pass Blocking and Pass Rushing Performance - Pipping-Gam n et al.md
title: Opponent-Adjusted Evaluation of NFL Pass Blocking and Pass Rushing Performance
one_line: Ridge-regularized Bradley-Terry models on 153,138 Hudl-tracked blocker-rusher interactions give opponent-adjusted OL and pass-rusher ratings; holdout and game-bootstrap validation are careful but gains are tiny.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Performance Analysis in the Brazilian Soccer League Applying Machine Learning Techniques to Team Evaluation - Barbeiro.md
title: Performance Analysis in the Brazilian Soccer League: Applying Machine Learning Techniques to Team Evaluation
one_line: Clusters the 20 Brazilian Serie A teams of 2019 into six k-means profiles from aggregated match stats and betting odds, explaining clusters with random forest and SHAP; tiny sample, descriptive.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Real-Time Basketball Jumpshot Detection on iOS A Comparative Analysis of Linear Regression and Random Forest Classification Using Apple s Vi - Meng.md
title: Real-Time Basketball Jumpshot Detection on iOS: A Comparative Analysis of Linear Regression and Random Forest Classification Using Apple’s Vision Framework
one_line: Compares unregularized linear regression and random forest for frame-level jumpshot detection from Apple Vision pose landmarks on iPhone; tiny self-recorded sample and frame-level random split overstate accuracy.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - The Contract Effect Why NHL Players Perform Differently When Money Is on the Line - Palisin.md
title: The Contract Effect: Why NHL Players Perform Differently When Money Is on the Line
one_line: Regresses NHL skater stats over five seasons around 278 multi-year signings (2013-2025) and fits ridge/RF/XGBoost to predict contract-year production; reports a 5.6-unit shortfall, muddled design.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - Against All Odds Leicester City s Triumphant Journey to Premier League Glory - Lu et al.md
title: Against All Odds: Leicester City’s Triumphant Journey to Premier League Glory
one_line: Rookie Review slides splitting Leicester's 2015-16 title into skill and luck with a payroll model, Pythagorean residuals and xG z-scores; descriptive, with an unexplained 15,000-to-1 figure.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - Poise or Panic Breaking Down QB Pressure - Hafiz et al.md
title: Poise or Panic? Breaking Down QB Pressure
one_line: Rookie Review slides computing a Voronoi pocket-shrink rate (PRSS) from tracking frames and relating binned values to yards gained; the R^2 of 0.51 is on bins, not plays.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2026/2026 - Predicting WHL Tournament Outcomes Bayesian Mixed-Effects Modeling and Monte Carlo Simulation - Zaslow et al.md
title: Predicting WHL Tournament Outcomes: Bayesian Mixed-Effects Modeling & Monte Carlo Simulation
one_line: Opponent-adjusted, phase-specific Bayesian xG team ratings plus Poisson Monte Carlo for a simulated hockey league’s first-round playoff games; sound workflow, untestable on real outcomes.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2025/2025 - The Curse of the Second Red Bull - Zahn et al.md
title: The Curse of the Second Red Bull
one_line: Slide deck regressing standardized qualifying time on driver, team, best session and team-by-year (2019-2025) to separate Verstappen from the second Red Bull car; results only in figures.

file: md/library/journals/Wharton Sports Analytics Journal/2023/2023 - The Drafting Dynasty Which NBA Franchise Dominates the Draft - Dandapani et al.md
title: The Drafting Dynasty: Which NBA Franchise Dominates the Draft?
one_line: Slide deck defining a 'J.O.K.I.C.' draft-value score from draft-class-standardized career average Win Shares scaled by pick and class strength, then ranking franchises; constants unexplained.
